relationship_to_primary_analysis: Exploratory presentation extension performed after the frozen primary analysis; it does not alter the cohort, endpoint, decision rule, estimates, or interpretation of the primary result.
eligible_cases: All 762 formal cases with status PASS and non-empty ground truth. No case is excluded on prediction quality, Dice, lesion-wise F1, PR-AUC, center, or visual appearance.

selection_rule.lesion_burden: Ground-truth lesion volume in millilitres, calculated as gt_voxels multiplied by voxel_volume_ml.

bands.small: Volume at or below the within-stratum 25th percentile.
bands.large: Volume at or above the within-stratum 75th percentile.

selection_rule.tie_breaker: Select the lexicographically smallest SHA-256 digest of token|IMA-QUAL-V1-20260929|band among eligible candidates.
selection_rule.performance_blinding: Only token, stratum, gt_voxels, gt_empty, status, and voxel_volume_ml may enter the selection function. Prediction-derived metrics are merged only after the six tokens have been fixed and written to the selection receipt.

display_rule.slice: Slice with the largest ground-truth lesion area; ties resolved by the lowest slice index.
display_rule.intensity: Per-case global nonzero T1 1st to 99.5th percentile linear window; no local or selective enhancement.
display_rule.full_view_crop: Bounding box of nonzero voxels on the selected T1 slice with fixed eight-pixel padding, clipped to image bounds.
display_rule.zoom: Ground-truth lesion bounding box on the selected slice, expanded to a square with at least 28 pixels of padding and clipped to image bounds.
display_rule.overlays: Ground truth in cyan and prediction in magenta; contours are drawn from unchanged binary arrays.
display_rule.scale_bar: 20 mm, derived from the NIfTI voxel spacing.
display_rule.labels: Anonymous case letter, source stratum, lesion-burden band, ground-truth volume, case-level Dice, and lesion-wise F1.

figure_contract.core_conclusion: The locked ensemble shows visibly heterogeneous lesion delineation across source strata and lesion burdens, while qualitative examples are selected independently of model performance.
figure_contract.evidence_chain: Three source strata by two lesion-burden bands; each panel links the full axial slice, a lesion-centred inset, unchanged ground truth and prediction contours, and fixed case-level metrics.

prohibited_actions: Replacing a selected case after viewing its image or performance
Using this figure to claim prospective, independent, or clinical validation
Recasting the frozen primary analysis as statistically significant
